dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a smooth concave curvature conforming to a parabolic spline from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is classified as rounded with a medium pixel radius relative to the total fin height.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The leading edge is steeply convex, measured at approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the maximum base width to the maximum vertical height is approximately 1.1:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon presents a broad, smoothly convex arc radius visible along the anterior-dorsal boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of approximately five vertical, parallel linear rake marks on the lateral flank, positioned ventral to the anterior dorsal fin insertion.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct dark dorsal cape with a visible ventral dip below the dorsal fin; optical caustic patterns from light refraction are visible across the ventral-posterior flank.
